title: Playmate but better
description: Playmate but for Fabric instead of Forge.
body: This was a mod originally made by Danila_Podpivas for Forge. Using the Kilt mod it can now be played on Fabric if you so prefer. (FYI Kilt is an experimental mod, there is a possibility it may not work) If you do not already know what the playmate is, it is an entity that will randomly begin a "game" of hide and seek. If you are seeking, then it will give you 60 seconds to find it 3 times. If you are hiding, then it has 60 seconds to find you.
